laws.rule: Visitors to Boracay (Malay, Aklan) register and pay through the Boracay iPass system run for the Aklan provincial government, and enter with the QR code it issues. The rate guide lists a one-way port terminal fee of PHP 150 (about A$3.35, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) and an environmental fee of PHP 300 (about A$6.69) for foreign guests; children pay neither.
laws.heading: Provincial Government of Aklan

local-law.note: Boracay is in Aklan province; the place tree holds Western Visayas region.
